meta.source: BZ Brand Guidelines PDF (11 pages); website values from basmeh-zeitooneh.org, measured 2026-09-29

tokens.name: burgundy
tokens.usage: THE brand colour (primary palette). Logo mark, headings on light grounds, burgundy panels, primary buttons. White text on it is 11.4:1.

tokens.name: burgundy-dark
tokens.usage: From the website palette (theme colour 2). Hover state for burgundy buttons and links. Not in the PDF guidelines.

tokens.name: blush
tokens.usage: Primary palette tint. Soft panels and highlight fills behind burgundy or black text (burgundy on blush 8.3:1). Too light for text on white.

tokens.name: mauve
tokens.usage: Primary palette mid tone. Dividers on burgundy, secondary fills, the accent text colour in dark theme. Never as text on white (2.1:1).

tokens.name: grey-100
tokens.usage: Primary palette light grey. Alternate section background on light layouts.

tokens.name: charcoal
tokens.usage: Dark ground for the white logo (brand's non-burgundy dark background) and the body text colour used in the guidelines.

tokens.name: grey-dark
tokens.usage: From the website palette (theme colour 16). A warm dark grey for dark bands such as the top utility bar. Not in the PDF guidelines.

tokens.name: olive
tokens.usage: Secondary palette. The wordmark green in the coloured logo. Safe as text on white (7.4:1) and as a fill under white text.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: Secondary palette. Charts, illustrations and highlights. Fill only; put black or charcoal text on it, never white.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Secondary palette. Charts and infographics. As text on white only at 24px+ (4.4:1).

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Secondary palette. Charts and illustrations. Fill only; black text on it.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Secondary palette. Charts and illustrations. White text on it only at 24px+ (4.4:1). Not an error colour by default: pair with a word if it signals status.

tokens.name: orchid
tokens.usage: Secondary palette. Charts and illustrations. Fill only; black text on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. The coloured logo sits only on this light ground; in dark theme use the white logo.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Alternate bands and cards. Light value is grey-100, which is also the website's page background.

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: Soft branded panel. Light value is blush.

tokens.name: surface-brand
tokens.usage: Burgundy panels: covers, section openers, banners. Use the white logo and on-brand text on it.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface, surface-alt and surface-tint (black is a brand text colour). 15:1+ in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text and long body copy (brand text grey #4d4b4d). On surface and surface-alt: 7.5:1+ light, 6.8:1+ dark. This is also the website's default body text colour.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Captions, image credits, side-rail labels. Light value is the guidelines' caption grey and is 4.0:1 on white: keep it to 13px+ non-essential labels, or use ink-soft.

tokens.name: heading
tokens.usage: Section headings (Vision, Mission, Consistency). Burgundy on light grounds 9.9:1+; mauve in dark theme 7:1+.

tokens.name: heading-secondary
tokens.usage: From the website: news and card titles use olive (the site theme's default heading colour). Section headings stay `heading` (burgundy), as the guidelines show. 7.4:1 on white; mint 6.6:1 on dark surface.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links in body text (website: burgundy).

tokens.name: link-hover
tokens.usage: Link hover (website: burgundy-dark).

tokens.name: input-bg
tokens.usage: Form field fill, from the website's newsletter field.

tokens.name: input-border
tokens.usage: Form field border, from the website (mauve, 0.8px). Light value is only 2.1:1 on white, below the 3:1 for control borders; kept as the site uses it. Use line-strong where a field must stand out.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Text-selection background (website); selected text is on-brand white.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and the white logo on surface-brand and burgundy fills (11.4:1).

tokens.name: on-brand-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text on burgundy (8.3:1).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline rules, like the thin grey rules beside palette labels. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders; 3:1+ on surface in both themes.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px solid ring with a 2px gap in the page colour. 3:1+ on every surface.

families.display: "Helvetica Neue Condensed", "HelveticaNeue-CondensedBold", "Helvetica Neue LT Std", "Roboto Condensed", "Arial Narrow", Arial, sans-serif
families.arabic: "DIN Next LT Arabic", "Noto Kufi Arabic", Tahoma, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Cover and poster titles in Helvetica Neue Condensed Bold ('Brand Guidelines').

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Short uppercase labels, the wordmark's own treatment. Set text-transform: uppercase.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings in the heading colour (Vision, Mission, About B&Z).

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: News and card titles in heading-secondary (website: 20px, 600).

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: Intro paragraphs and subtitles, often on burgundy ('Your Quick Guide to Our Visual Identity').
styles.sample: Your quick guide to our visual identity

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Running text, Helvetica Neue Light, in ink or ink-soft. Line height 1.65 comes from the website.
styles.sample: A refugee-led relief and development organization.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body text and button labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Captions under images and side notes, in ink-faint or ink-soft.

styles.name: rail
styles.usage: The rotated section label on the page's left rail (Logo Usage, Color Palette).

styles.name: arabic-heading
styles.usage: Arabic headings in DIN Next LT Arabic. Set dir="rtl".

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps inside labels.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gaps, tag padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of standard buttons (website: 12px 24px), small stacks.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap between related items.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of the website's compact header button (Donate: 5px 20px).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between paragraphs and headings; horizontal padding of standard buttons (website: 12px 24px).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between sections within a page.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page margins on slides and wide layouts.

tokens.name: space-15
tokens.usage: Vertical space between page sections on the website (theme content spacing).

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Space around the logo on covers.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Panels, images and full-bleed bands: square, as in the guidelines.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons and form fields, as measured on the website (Donate, View Programs, newsletter field).

tokens.name: radius-slider
tokens.usage: The white uppercase buttons on the website's hero slider (Learn more, Donate through JustGiving).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Colour swatch discs only, as on the palette page.

layout.note: Page widths and control sizes measured on basmeh-zeitooneh.org.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Maximum width of standard page content on the website.

tokens.name: container-narrow
tokens.usage: Maximum width of narrow, text-led pages (articles).

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Rendered height of the website's header Donate button; the theme minimum is 30px.

tokens.name: field-height
tokens.usage: Height of the website's newsletter email field.
